# Taxes

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List taxes

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes`

Retrieve a paginated list of taxes with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, taxGroup, cashBasisTransitionAccount, country, creator, childrenTaxes, invoiceRepartitionLines, refundRepartitionLines | `invoiceRepartitionLines,refundRepartitionLines` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by tax name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | integer | No | Filter by company ID |  |
| `filter[tax_group_id]` | integer | No | Filter by tax group ID |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | integer | No | Filter by country ID |  |
| `filter[type_tax_use]` | string | No | Filter by tax type usage |  |
| `filter[amount_type]` | string | No | Filter by amount type |  |
| `filter[tax_scope]` | string | No | Filter by tax scope |  |
| `filter[price_include_override]` | string | No | Filter by price include override |  |
| `filter[is_active]` | boolean | No | Filter by active status |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes?include=invoiceRepartitionLines%2CrefundRepartitionLines&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",

## Create tax

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes`

Create a new tax

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Tax name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `type_tax_use` | string | Yes | Tax type usage. |
| `amount_type` | string | Yes | Tax computation type. |
| `amount` | number | Yes | Tax amount/percentage. Not used when the computation is "group" or "code". Must be at least 0. |
| `formula` | string | No | Arithmetic formula used when the computation is "code". Supports numbers, + - * / ( ), the functions min, max and the variables price_unit, quantity, price_subtotal. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `tax_group_id` | integer | Yes | Tax group ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `tax_scope` | string | No | Tax scope. |
| `price_include_override` | string | No | Price include override. |
| `cash_basis_transition_account_id` | integer | No | Cash basis transition account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `description` | string | No | Tax description. |
| `invoice_label` | string | No | Label to display on invoices. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `invoice_legal_notes` | string | No | Legal notes to display on invoices. |
| `tax_exigibility` | string | No | Tax exigibility. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Tax status active/inactive. |
| `include_base_amount` | boolean | No | Include base amount in tax calculation. |
| `is_base_affected` | boolean | No | Is base affected by other taxes. |
| `analytic` | boolean | No | Enable analytic accounting. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines` | object[] | Yes | Tax repartition lines for invoices (at least 1 base and 1 tax line required). For updates: include "id" to update existing line, omit to create new. Lines not included will be deleted. Must have at least 2 items. |
| `refund_repartition_lines` | object[] | Yes | Tax repartition lines for refunds (must match invoice lines structure). For updates: include "id" to update existing line, omit to create new. Lines not included will be deleted. Must have at least 2 items. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].repartition_type` | string | Yes |  |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].factor_percent` | number | No | Must be at least -100. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].use_in_tax_closing` | boolean | No |  |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].repartition_type` | string | Yes |  |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].factor_percent` | number | No | Must be at least -100. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].use_in_tax_closing` | boolean | No |  |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "VAT 20%",

  "include_base_amount": false,

    {
      "repartition_type": "base",

    },
    {
      "repartition_type": "tax",
      "factor_percent": 100,
      "account_id": 1,

    }
  ]
}'
```

## Show tax

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes/{id}`

Retrieve a specific tax by its ID

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The tax ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, taxGroup, cashBasisTransitionAccount, country, creator, childrenTaxes, invoiceRepartitionLines, refundRepartitionLines | `invoiceRepartitionLines,refundRepartitionLines` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes/{id}?include=invoiceRepartitionLines%2CrefundRepartitionLines" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Update tax

<Badge type="tip" text="PUT" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes/{id}`

Update an existing tax

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The tax ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | No | Tax name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `type_tax_use` | string | No | Tax type usage. |
| `amount_type` | string | No | Tax computation type. |
| `amount` | number | No | Tax amount/percentage. Not used when the computation is "group" or "code". Must be at least 0. |
| `formula` | string | No | Arithmetic formula used when the computation is "code". Supports numbers, + - * / ( ), the functions min, max and the variables price_unit, quantity, price_subtotal. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `tax_group_id` | integer | No | Tax group ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `tax_scope` | string | No | Tax scope. |
| `price_include_override` | string | No | Price include override. |
| `cash_basis_transition_account_id` | integer | No | Cash basis transition account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `description` | string | No | Tax description. |
| `invoice_label` | string | No | Label to display on invoices. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `invoice_legal_notes` | string | No | Legal notes to display on invoices. |
| `tax_exigibility` | string | No | Tax exigibility. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Tax status active/inactive. |
| `include_base_amount` | boolean | No | Include base amount in tax calculation. |
| `is_base_affected` | boolean | No | Is base affected by other taxes. |
| `analytic` | boolean | No | Enable analytic accounting. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines` | object[] | No | Tax repartition lines for invoices (at least 1 base and 1 tax line required). For updates: include "id" to update existing line, omit to create new. Lines not included will be deleted. Must have at least 2 items. |
| `refund_repartition_lines` | object[] | No | Tax repartition lines for refunds (must match invoice lines structure). For updates: include "id" to update existing line, omit to create new. Lines not included will be deleted. Must have at least 2 items. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].repartition_type` | string | Yes |  |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].factor_percent` | number | No | Must be at least -100. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_repartition_lines[].use_in_tax_closing` | boolean | No |  |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].repartition_type` | string | Yes |  |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].factor_percent` | number | No | Must be at least -100. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].account_id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `refund_repartition_lines[].use_in_tax_closing` | boolean | No |  |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X PUT "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/taxes/{id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "VAT 20%",
  "type_tax_use": "sale",
  "amount_type": "percent",
  "amount": 20,
  "formula": "min(price_unit * quantity * 0.2, 500)",
  "tax_group_id": 1,
  "company_id": 1,
  "country_id": 233,
  "tax_scope": "service",
  "price_include_override": "default",
  "cash_basis_transition_account_id": 1,
  "description": "Standard VAT rate",
  "invoice_label": "VAT",
  "invoice_legal_notes": "Subject to VAT regulations",
  "tax_exigibility": "on_invoice",
  "is_active": true,
  "include_base_amount": false,
  "is_base_affected": false,
  "analytic": false,
  "invoice_repartition_lines": [
    {
      "repartition_type": "base",
      "factor_percent": null,
      "account_id": null,
      "use_in_tax_closing": false
    },
    {
      "repartition_type": "tax",
      "factor_percent": 100,
      "account_id": 1,
      "use_in_tax_closing": false
    }
  ],
  "refund_repartition_lines": [
    {
      "repartition_type": "base",
      "factor_percent": null,
      "account_id": null,
      "use_in_tax_closing": true
    },
    {
      "repartition_type": "tax",
      "factor_percent": 100,
      "account_id": 1,
      "use_in_tax_closing": false
    }
  ]
}'
```
